headlines.title: Police knew who her rapist was. The law kept them from prosecuting him for the attack.
headlines.description: After a certain point in some states, there’s no way to hold a perpetrator accountable for sexual assaults.

headlines.title: Letitia James takes over Cornell rape investigation as special prosecutor
headlines.description: The move comes after New York Governor Kathy Hochul said she had lost confidence in the local district attorney’s handling of the case. It comes as NBC News has obtained hundreds of pages of documents from Cornell’s Title IX proceedings. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Trump delivers campaign remarks in Alabama
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Donald Trump delivers campaign remarks for Republicans in Mobile, Alabama.

headlines.title: Vance talks 2028, Ted Cruz and a tough midterm climate that could affect his future
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance said the GOP faces an “uphill climb” in the midterms — and that the results may be a data point he reviews as he decides his 2028 plans.

headlines.title: How 16 undecided voters are weighing their 2026 election options
headlines.description: The voters, who participated in a recent NBC News poll and spoke to reporters afterward, are laser-focused on high prices and largely disappointed with both parties.

headlines.title: Democrats regain ground on voter registration in key states after steep post-2024 drops
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk analysis of voter file data in seven states found that Democrats managed to reverse or slow their registration decline over the past year.

headlines.title: Christa Pike unconscious and on a ventilator after failed execution
headlines.description: Lawyers for Christa Pike say she is critically ill, intubated, and on a ventilator at a hospital in Tennessee. She survived two lethal doses during the attempted execution for a murder she committed when she was 18. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: G7 countries to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil reserves
headlines.description: Group of Seven countries agreed to release tens of millions of barrels of diesel fuel and crude to cap soaring gas prices.

headlines.title: Pilot Stabbed in Flydubai Attack Shares His Story for the First Time
headlines.description: The pilot that was stabbed during the suspected terror attack on a Flydubai plane is speaking out for the first time about his desperate decision to fight back and open the cockpit door that saved lives, getting emotional as he reflected on the near-disaster. “I feel proud of myself…I didn’t feel it until now, but now I do,” he says. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
